definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.ruled_surface_generator, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: Classical; one of the two doubly ruled quadrics.

cross_checked.detail: page title 'One-sheeted hyperboloid' vs record name 'Hyperboloid of One Sheet'

caveats: DOUBLY ruled: two distinct families of straight lines lie on it, which is what makes cooling towers and Shukhov's lattice towers buildable from straight members.
